_doc: Single source of truth for all secrets and env vars. Run 'node scripts/check-env-sync.js' to validate ci.yml matches this.

ru.data_dir: n/a — ru-edge has no agent-data (no Claude sessions); only USERS_DIR (vacancy drafts) and AGENT_TOKENS_DIR (.chatid files for notifications)
ru._note: Thin RU-IP edge (src/ru-edge.js, issue #1288) — no Claude Code, no runner, no MCP. Runs nalog.ru/ESIA login, /playwright-fetch, and vacancy pages. Formerly a full assist-agent instance (systemd/assist-agent-ru.service, retired).

bots._doc: Bot registry (epic #1342) — the ONE source of truth for Telegram bots. Adding a bot = 1 entry here + its token in GCP Secret Manager + the name in src/secrets.js OPTIONAL. gateway_url = that bot's gateway Worker (run-finished / held-messages callbacks must reach the gateway that dispatched the run; default uses env MEDIA_GATEWAY_URL). A bot with NO gateway of our tg-bot family MUST set gateway_absence_reason to a non-empty explanation instead of leaving gateway_url silently empty — enforced by src/bot-registry.js botsMissingGatewayDeclaration() and test/gateway-callback.test.cjs. botId/audience come from the transport (webhook path / bot token), never from message text or LLM args. check-env-sync.js validates every entry; scripts/check-bot-secrets.js --live probes Secret Manager after each GCP deploy; src/secrets.js alerts the operator at boot when an enabled bot's token is missing.

registry.gateway_absence_reason: Внешний сейлс-бот @cmr_management_bot = Cloudflare Worker flexi-telegram-deal-bot (репо kobzevvv/flexi-exhibition-deal-bot), НЕ экземпляр trained-assist-tg-bot. Он зовёт агента POST /run и ждёт ответа в своём чате: держать busy-холд и слушать /internal/run-finished ему нечем, поэтому агент шлёт финальный текст напрямую через sendMessage токеном SALES_BOT_TOKEN. Регистрация обязательна: без своей аудитории агент отвечал токеном классического бота, которого в группах нет (выгнут из -1004485888030) → sendMessage 403 ПОСЛЕ 202, и оператор видел только «⏳ Передаю ассистенту…» навсегда. Воркер обязан передавать audience: sales.

app.name: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEYS

The llm-ladder worker keeps its own Go key pool for every ladder (#1687) — this list only feeds runs pinned straight to opencode-go. Written to secrets.env by BOTH ci.yml and deploy-manual.yml (drift checked by scripts/check-env-sync.js).

app.name: CRED_ENCRYPTION_KEY

app.name: SERPER_API_KEY
app.description: Serper (Google SERP) key for the search_serper MCP tool — the backup web-search engine of epic #1792, shipped by the trained-assist-search-skill sibling. GCP only (issue #1288: ru-edge has no MCP); bypasses src/secrets.js like INN_* and reaches the MCP child via browser.js mcpToolEnv.

app.name: SALES_BOT_TOKEN
app.description: Telegram bot token of @cmr_management_bot — reply credential for the external flexi-telegram-deal-bot worker (bots.registry botId=sales). REQUIRED, not optional: an enabled bot whose token cannot be resolved makes scripts/check-bot-secrets.js fail, which closes the pre-deploy gate (scripts/check-deploy-secrets-gate.js) and freezes EVERY release — the 01.10.2026 incident that pinned prod to a1d8410. It also used to be declared ONLY in gcp_secret_manager_only, i.e. it had no automated path into the host at all: the deploy job rewrites /home/vova/secrets.env from GitHub Secrets, so a value that exists only in nobody's hands can never reach prod, and the gate reads the host env as fallback. Now delivered like every other GCP secret (GitHub Secret SALES_BOT_TOKEN → ci.yml/deploy-manual.yml printf → secrets.env), Secret Manager still wins when it has a value. Never fall back to the classic bot token — it is not a member of the sales groups (sendMessage 403 AFTER 202, operator sees «⏳ Передаю ассистенту…» forever). Not written to RU (ru-edge has no runner/bot-delivery).

checklist_add_new_secret: 1. Add to src/secrets.js — REQUIRED or OPTIONAL array + return object
2. Add to infra/env-manifest.json — github_actions_secrets.app with written_to and gcp_sm fields
3. Add to GCP Secret Manager: echo -n 'value' | gcloud secrets create SECRET_NAME --data-file=- --project=alesa-personal-assistent
4. Add to GitHub repo Secrets (Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions)
5. Add to .github/workflows/ci.yml printf block for each VM listed in written_to
6. Run: node scripts/check-env-sync.js — must pass before commit
7. If GCP-only (not in written_to): add to gcp_secret_manager_only section instead
8. A Telegram bot token? Also add a bots.registry entry (botId, audience, token_secret_name) — delivery routing reads it from there
